translations.web: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
translations.bsb: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because you will not experience any loss of life, but only of the ship.
translations.kjv: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
translations.asv: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer; for there shall be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
